{"path": "imagenet_trend.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches

# ImageNet top-1 accuracy data
years = [2012, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]
accuracies = [63.3, 74.4, 76.1, 77.4, 82.7, 83.0, 84.4, 85.2, 86.0, 91.0, 90.0, 91.6]
models = ['AlexNet', 'VGG-16', 'ResNet-50', 'DenseNet', 'SENet', 'NASNet', 
          'EfficientNet-B7', 'ViT-L', 'CoAtNet', 'CoCa', 'EVA-02', 'InternViT']

# CNN models (pre-2020) vs Transformer models (2020+)
cnn_models = ['AlexNet', 'VGG-16', 'ResNet-50', 'DenseNet', 'SENet', 'NASNet', 'EfficientNet-B7']
transformer_models = ['ViT-L', 'CoAtNet', 'CoCa', 'EVA-02', 'InternViT']

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Plot the trend line
ax.plot(years, accuracies, 'o-', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10, color='#2E86AB', label='ImageNet Top-1 Accuracy')

# Highlight CNN era (2012-2019)
cnn_years = years[:7]
cnn_accs = accuracies[:7]
ax.fill_between(cnn_years, min(accuracies), max(accuracies), alpha=0.15, color='#A23B72', label='CNN Era')

# Highlight Transformer era (2020-2024)
trans_years = years[7:]
trans_accs = accuracies[7:]
ax.fill_between(trans_years, min(accuracies), max(accuracies), alpha=0.15, color='#F18F01', label='Transformer Era')

# Select 5 representative milestones to label
milestones = [
    (2012, 63.3, 'AlexNet\n(CNN)\n63.3%'),
    (2015, 76.1, 'ResNet-50\n(CNN)\n76.1%'),
    (2017, 82.7, 'SENet\n(CNN)\n82.7%'),
    (2020, 85.2, 'ViT-L\n(Transformer)\n85.2%'),
    (2022, 91.0, 'CoCa\n(Transformer)\n91.0%'),
    (2024, 91.6, 'InternViT\n(Transformer)\n91.6%')
]

# Add milestone labels
for year, acc, label in milestones:
    idx = years.index(year)
    ax.annotate(label, 
                xy=(year, acc), 
                xytext=(0, 15), 
                textcoords='offset points',
                ha='center', 
                fontsize=10,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.9),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.3', color='gray'))

# Add vertical line at 2020 to mark the transition
ax.axvline(x=2020, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7, label='Transformer Revolution')

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('ImageNet Top-1 Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('ImageNet Top-1 Accuracy: From CNNs to Transformers (2012-2024)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlim(2011, 2025)
ax.set_ylim(60, 95)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle=':')

# Add legend
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=10)

# Add era annotations
ax.text(2013, 65, 'Traditional CNNs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#A23B72',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
ax.text(2022, 65, 'Modern Transformers', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#F18F01',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('imagenet_trend.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Plot saved as imagenet_trend.png")
plt.show()"}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches

# ImageNet top-1 accuracy data
years = [2012, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]
accuracies = [63.3, 74.4, 76.1, 77.4, 82.7, 83.0, 84.4, 85.2, 86.0, 91.0, 90.0, 91.6]
models = ['AlexNet', 'VGG-16', 'ResNet-50', 'DenseNet', 'SENet', 'NASNet', 
          'EfficientNet-B7', 'ViT-L', 'CoAtNet', 'CoCa', 'EVA-02', 'InternViT']

# CNN models (pre-2020) vs Transformer models (2020+)
cnn_models = ['AlexNet', 'VGG-16', 'ResNet-50', 'DenseNet', 'SENet', 'NASNet', 'EfficientNet-B7']
transformer_models = ['ViT-L', 'CoAtNet', 'CoCa', 'EVA-02', 'InternViT']

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Plot the trend line
ax.plot(years, accuracies, 'o-', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10, color='#2E86AB', label='ImageNet Top-1 Accuracy')

# Highlight CNN era (2012-2019)
cnn_years = years[:7]
cnn_accs = accuracies[:7]
ax.fill_between(cnn_years, min(accuracies), max(accuracies), alpha=0.15, color='#A23B72', label='CNN Era')

# Highlight Transformer era (2020-2024)
trans_years = years[7:]
trans_accs = accuracies[7:]
ax.fill_between(trans_years, min(accuracies), max(accuracies), alpha=0.15, color='#F18F01', label='Transformer Era')

# Select 5 representative milestones to label
milestones = [
    (2012, 63.3, 'AlexNet\n(CNN)\n63.3%'),
    (2015, 76.1, 'ResNet-50\n(CNN)\n76.1%'),
    (2017, 82.7, 'SENet\n(CNN)\n82.7%'),
    (2020, 85.2, 'ViT-L\n(Transformer)\n85.2%'),
    (2022, 91.0, 'CoCa\n(Transformer)\n91.0%'),
    (2024, 91.6, 'InternViT\n(Transformer)\n91.6%')
]

# Add milestone labels
for year, acc, label in milestones:
    idx = years.index(year)
    ax.annotate(label, 
                xy=(year, acc), 
                xytext=(0, 15), 
                textcoords='offset points',
                ha='center', 
                fontsize=10,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.9),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.3', color='gray'))

# Add vertical line at 2020 to mark the transition
ax.axvline(x=2020, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7, label='Transformer Revolution')

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('ImageNet Top-1 Accuracy: From CNNs to Transformers (2012-2024)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlim(2011, 2025)
ax.set_ylim(60, 95)

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

function.name: find
function.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

function.name: ls
function.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

function.name: workflow_plan
function.description: Register a hierarchical workflow plan. Provide 3-5 main steps at the top level with description, outputFiles, verifiers, and optional children.

function.name: ask_user_question
function.description: Ask the operator a structured question and wait for the answer.
